about: SCION 21 photo-to-actor: the dog measured from its own rendered alpha layer, per scene frame. state = measured state (onsets below); state_score = the score's label for comparison.

onsets_measured.rule: centroid moves away from the door > 0.5 px/frame
head end rises 3 px from its lowest point in the retreat
mask change: head-end/turn sprite replaces the profile (IoU < 0.8 or head-end jump > 4 px)
head end changes (IoU < 0.9 or head-end jump > 4 px) while the body lies
centroid moves toward the door > 0.3 px/frame
back line drops 3 px below its height on the approach
first head-end mask change after the cut to the close shot (IoU < 0.97 or head-end top moves >= 2 px)

summary.mapping: plate x = 330 + 180 * x_score - 54 (the score x is the dog's loins, 0.3 m behind its body centre). Wide static camera except a 2x close shot on the sill at frames 634-677 (26.42-28.21 s, window x 40-680, y 360-720); x_world_measured is the measured plate centroid in metres for every frame; x_screen is the plate centroid, x_screen_close the on-screen centroid in the close shot
